kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Separate USB connector shape from the required USB data rate, power role and optional video function.
copy.zh: 区分USB接口外形与所需数据速率、供电角色及视频功能。

copy.en: Define load current, cable length and conductor size; verify voltage at the device under load.
copy.zh: 明确负载电流、长度与导体规格，并验证带载时设备端电压。

copy.en: Review CC wiring, connector orientation and any required identification or power-negotiation electronics.
copy.zh: 审核CC接法、接口方向及所需识别或供电协商电路。

copy.en: For active FTDI variants, distinguish TTL UART, RS232 and RS485 electrical interfaces and required host drivers.
copy.zh: 对FTDI有源转换型号，区分TTL UART、RS232、RS485电平与主机驱动要求。

copy.en: Define data-pair construction, shield termination and device-specific signal validation for the selected length.
copy.zh: 定义数据线对结构、屏蔽端接及所选长度的设备信号验证。

copy.en: Specify bend, pull, insertion and enclosure requirements; a charge-only lead is not a data cable.
copy.zh: 明确弯折、拉力、插拔与机壳要求，并区分仅充电线与数据线。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
